UpdateStageName: Prepare S1DS data directories and environment file
UpdateSourceArgs:
-c "docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo ERROR: Docker daemon not reachable. This application must run directly on the host, not inside an AMP container, and the AMP user needs to be in the docker group. Recreate the instance with container mode disabled.; exit 1; }; mkdir -p '{{$FullRootDir}}game' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamhome'; setfacl -R -m u:1000:rwX -m d:u:1000:rwX -m u:$(id -u):rwX -m d:u:$(id -u):rwX '{{$FullRootDir}}game' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamhome' 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -f '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd/steamcmd.sh' ]; then docker run --rm -v '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd:/mnt' --entrypoint /bin/sh ghcr.io/ifbars/s1dedicatedservers:{{ImageTag}} -c 'cp -a /home/steam/steamcmd/. /mnt/'; fi; docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/cat ghcr.io/ifbars/s1dedicatedservers:{{ImageTag}} /home/steam/run.sh > '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh.orig' && sed -e 's#^    --steam-gs-anonymous$#    --steam-gs-anonymous
    --stdio-console#' -e 's#^GAME_PID=.*#&
tail -n0 -F /home/steam/game/MelonLoader/Latest.log 2>/dev/null \&#' '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh.orig' > '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh' && chmod +x '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh'; printf 'S1DS_RUNTIME=%s
STEAM_USER=%s
STEAM_PASS=%s
STEAM_GUARD=%s
FORCE_STEAMCMD_UPDATE=false
' '{{Runtime}}' '{{SteamUser}}' '{{SteamPass}}' '{{SteamGuard}}' > '{{$FullRootDir}}s1ds.env' && chmod 600 '{{$FullRootDir}}s1ds.env'; docker rm -f s1ds-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; CFG='{{$FullRootDir}}game/UserData/server_config.toml'; if [ -f $CFG ]; then sed -i 's#^serverName = .*#serverName = \x27{{ServerName}}\x27#; s#^serverPassword = .*#serverPassword = \x27{{ServerPassword}}\x27#; s#^maxPlayers = .*#maxPlayers = {{$MaxUsers}}#; s#^steamGameServerQueryPort = .*#steamGameServerQueryPort = 27018#' $CFG; fi"
